findings:
🟡 [probe-step-dropped-on-reject] MUST-FIX In runCampaignIntake the probe decision is only kept when status !== 'rejected' (`if (decision.status !== 'rejected') cleanroomProbeSteps.push(decision)`), and the final_panel_seat_cleanroom_unavailable return sends `steps: [rejection]` (campaign_generation only); the qualification-failure return between the blind block and the enforce check likewise omits cleanroomProbeSteps. Spec §1.2 requires the probe result to be a `cleanroom_probe` step in the intake receipt carrying runner/exit_status/launcher/deny_paths/launcher_json precisely so the answering launcher (env override) and the deny list are visible when the probe fails; today a rejected probe leaves only the reason string, so an operator cannot tell which launcher answered or what was denied. Smallest fix: push every decision (including rejected) into cleanroomProbeSteps, and return `steps: [...cleanroomProbeSteps, rejection]` in the cleanroom-unavailable and post-probe qualification-failure branches (mirror to platforms/codex/plugin/src/engine/campaign-intake.js).
🔵 [probe-before-none-refusal] CUT/FOLLOW-UP When a roster mixes a none-tier seat and a codex seat, the launcher is spawned even though blindFailures will refuse the intake anyway; deferring the probe until blindFailures is empty avoids a wasted process. Excluded: spec fixes the loop order as tier/probe → qualification and the extra spawn has no correctness effect.
🔵 [head-evidence-not-supplied] CUT/FOLLOW-UP No §4.1 run output at the candidate was included with the dispatch; the new routing shadow case (non-git fixture reaching the `cleanroom_probe` step via the shared `steps` array), the resolver parity loop (`--check-scorecard` emitting JSON for every enum runner with `@none` endpoint), and the "cleanroom seat requires a review packet" assertion depend on base behaviour not visible in the diff. Excluded from MUST-FIX because nothing in the diff is shown wrong; depth-0 should attach the twelve exit-0 records before sealing.
